requestedText: Add same-module validation tests for the Weekly Radar Markdown Renderer interface.

evidence: The renderer module tests use only in-memory Rust values and no runtime loading.
The renderer module tests add no publisher, scheduler, persistence adapter, or external consumer.
The renderer module tests add no monitoring, telemetry, delivery, or runtime integration.
The Contract permits same-module coverage tests for the renderer boundary and excludes shared policy changes.
